key_insight: The paper introduces an ontology-based way to package variational quantum algorithm runs as machine-readable records so they can be reproduced, validated, and queried consistently.
engineering_relevance: It gives quantum software teams a structured metadata standard for tracking the many execution choices that affect VQA outcomes, from ansatz and optimizer to backend, noise, and software versions.
method: Built an OWL ontology to model core VQA entities and execution context.
Added SHACL constraints to check completeness and consistency of records.
Used SPARQL competency queries to retrieve reproducibility-critical information.
evidence_signal: The framework is demonstrated on Variational Quantum Eigensolver execution records, including both valid examples and intentionally incomplete or inconsistent cases to show validation and querying behavior.
watch_item: Adoption depends on careful and complete metadata capture across tools and workflows; otherwise the ontology can flag issues but cannot recover missing experimental context.
paper_title: A Semantic Framework for Reproducible Variational Quantum Algorithm Execution Records
